CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
